prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 futuristic Nike Sportswear editorial poster. Show an adult woman with a feminine athletic silhouette, sleek messy updo, natural makeup, gold statement earrings, and confident editorial expression. She wears an oversized white minimalist sweatshirt with voluminous sleeves, glossy translucent parachute pants, and chunky white-orange Nike athletic sneakers. Pose her full-body in a dynamic wide-leg stance before large glossy coral-red organic inflatable sculptures on a neutral beige gradient studio background. Place huge white just typography behind her, with accurate small campaign copy Nike Sportswear 2025, Movement Bodies Culture, 001 2025, New Season New Energy, and engineered-for-motion details. Use soft diffused light, realistic fabric and translucent folds, polished reflections, and no watermark or extra text.
